title: Invisible mobs :3
description: uhh makes most common hostile mobs invisible :3
body:
soooo it makes some mobs invisible :3 (why wont i stop using ":3"..) 

so.. if u think hardcore is to easy for u. this resource pack is for u :3 (DARN IT I SAID :3 AGAIN)

ye. if u want a list of the mobs that are invisible, here ya yo :D (oh so i didnt use :3 that time)
- zombies and its variants
- skeltons and its variants
- creepers
- endermans (eyes are still visable)
- spiders and its variants (eyes are still visable)
- slimes and its variants
- ghasts
- blazes (the smoke and fire is still visable)
- phantoms (light visable trail)
- silverfishes
- witches

notice: u will die :3 (AAAAAA :3 I GOTTA STOP SAYING ":3")
